title: .netrc: several machine entries and a default entry
summary: A synthetic .netrc with two machine entries (one on a single line, one over three lines) and a default entry after them, each holding its own password.
rationale: One file carries several accounts in mixed layouts, with a catch-all default entry at the end. Each password is a separate secret; finding the first does not end the search.

expectation.rationale: Flag all three password tokens. curl documents machine entries followed by login and password, a default entry that matches any name and must come after all machine tokens, and the password token's sensitivity. The entry's logins and host names are not given spans.

sources.supports: default is the same as machine name except that default matches any name. There can be only one default token, and it must be after all machine tokens.
